architecture_constraints.css_system: Plain CSS files only (frontend/src/styles/*.css). Absolutely NO Tailwind CSS and NO shadcn/ui library.
architecture_constraints.file_extension: JavaScript files (.js) and plain CSS files
architecture_constraints.icons: Inline SVG stroke icons (Lucide-style). No icon CDN, no external scripts
architecture_constraints.compliance_prohibitions: STRICT COMPLIANCE: NEVER use betting, odds, tips, picks, stake, value, edge, or promotion words anywhere in code, copy, titles, placeholders, or tests
architecture_constraints.mandatory_disclaimer: Statistical analysis for information and entertainment. Not betting advice.

design_archetype.name: Swiss Tactical Performance & Cyber-Stadium Fusion
design_archetype.vibe: Precision tactical sports analysis hub, dense data clarity, high-contrast dark/light adaptability, zero clutter, high emotional focus

fonts.admin_font: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

typography.mobile_input_rule: ALL form inputs on viewports <= 768px MUST have font-size: 16px to prevent iOS forced zoom

public_shell.desktop_nav: Visible top bar links for viewports >= 769px

tabs: 'More' tab triggering full-screen or bottom sheet overlay

footer.exact_disclaimer: Statistical analysis for information and entertainment. Not betting advice.

public_shell.cookie_banner: Fixed bottom bar with accept/decline actions and privacy policy link

mobile_app_bar.more_sheet: Full-screen 'All tools' sheet with live search, grouped tool tiles, and Customize bar pinning

variants..btn--primary: background: var(--brand); color: var(--on-brand); border: none;
variants..btn--secondary: background: var(--surface2); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--border);
variants..btn--ghost: background: transparent; color: var(--text2); border: none;
variants..btn--danger: background: var(--down); color: var(--on-down, #FFFFFF); border: none;

button_classes_and_styles.accessibility_touch_target: Minimum 44px height/width for all interactive touch targets

responsive_component_adaptations.tables_to_cards: On screens <= 768px, data tables must automatically stack into clean mobile card layouts
responsive_component_adaptations.drawers_to_sheets: Side drawers (user detail, inspect) must open as full-screen sliding sheets on viewports <= 768px
responsive_component_adaptations.confirmation_dialogs: Destructive/action confirmation dialogs must align as bottom sheets on phones

accessibility_and_ux.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 text contrast for standard text; 3:1 for large text and key graphic boundaries
accessibility_and_ux.focus_ring: Visible 2px to 3px solid focus ring using var(--brand) with 2px offset on all keyboard-navigable elements
accessibility_and_ux.motion: Respect @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) by disabling non-essential transitions and animations
accessibility_and_ux.horizontal_scroll: Zero horizontal scroll at 320px - 390px viewports. Use minmax(0, 1fr) for grid columns

image_urls.description: Full view of lit football stadium at night
Corner flag on green pitch under stadium floodlights
Football player kicking ball during match

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, dialogs, drawers) and key metric cards MUST include explicit kebap-case data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow plain CSS guidelines in src/styles/*.css. Do not add Tailwind CSS or import Tailwind.
Ensure public site uses CSS custom properties injected from GET /api/site/config.
Use standard class names (.btn, .btn--primary, .btn--secondary, .btn--ghost, .btn--danger, .btn--sm, .btn--md, .btn--lg) for buttons.
Verify no forbidden compliance terms (betting, odds, tips, picks, stake, value, edge, promotion) exist in any UI text or tests.
Always render the exact disclaimer in the footer: 'Statistical analysis for information and entertainment. Not betting advice.'
Ensure all interactive elements have valid data-testid attributes for testing.
